<quote by="Proposed: Sarangrave, Seconded: Conscience of the Senate">To commission the Gardens of the Perfect World in Occursion, Zenith. This will create a ministry that allows trade with Tsark, trading weirwood and/or liao for white granite. This offers the choice for further trade with the hermit kingdom. This position is approved by the National Assembly. Self-funded.
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[ministry]] in Occursion, Zenith
* Passed
* More information can be found in the '''[[Poets_light_but_lamps#Garden_of_the_Perfect_World|Poets light but lamps]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Winter 387YE

==Cost==

* 15 wains of weirwood
* 45 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete
